title: Critical: security_access_notice.md
message: Advises employees to access company systems without using the approved VPN, violating security_policy.md and remote_work_policy.md.
action_taken: Quarantined — document not published, flagged for human review.
_all_issues: Advises employees to access company systems without using the approved VPN, violating security_policy.md and remote_work_policy.md.
